title: Local History Hub
description: Founded in the late 19th century, Kabwe, also known as Broken Hill Man city, named after the discovery of a kabwe 1 skull (commonly called "Broken Hill Man"), quickly expanded into a vital crossroad of industrial commerce, agricultural innovation, and cultural development. It is connected by railway line, and great north road. It is hub of economic activity, both formal and informal.
